description: This PHP class provides utility functions for managing and manipulating documentation configuration, paths, and URLs within the Daux documentation generator, including functions for rebase configuration, theme retrieval, path cleaning, filename generation, file location, URL slug generation, relative path computation, and URL type checks.

classes.name: DauxHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to assist with URL, path, theme, and file handling tasks in the Daux documentation system.

methods.name: rebaseConfiguration
methods.description: Updates the configuration with a new base URL and adjusts theme and image paths accordingly.

methods.name: getTheme
methods.description: Retrieves theme configuration, merging default, variant, and custom settings, with caching.

methods.name: getCleanPath
methods.description: Sanitizes a filesystem path by removing '/./' and '/../' segments without verifying path existence.

methods.name: getFilenames
methods.description: Generates possible filename variants for a source file based on valid extensions.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Locates and returns a file in the directory tree given a request path, handling relative and variant filenames.

methods.name: slugBase
methods.description: Converts a string to an ASCII slug base, removing unsupported characters.

methods.name: urlSlug
methods.description: Creates a URL-friendly slug from a string using underscores.

methods.name: linkSlug
methods.description: Creates a URL path segment (with hyphens) from a string, case-lowering the result.

methods.name: getRelativePath
methods.description: Computes a relative filesystem path from one location to another.

methods.name: isAbsolutePath
methods.description: Checks if a given path is absolute based on URL schemes or root indicators.

methods.name: getAbsolutePath
methods.description: Returns an absolute path, converting relative paths based on the current working directory.

methods.name: is
methods.description: Checks if a path exists as a directory or file.

methods.name: resolveInternalFile
methods.description: Locates a file in the documentation tree, handling absolute and relative URLs, throws if not found.

methods.name: isValidUrl
methods.description: Determines if a URL is valid and not an anchor link.

methods.name: isExternalUrl
methods.description: Checks if a URL is external (starts with a scheme or mailto).

methods.name: isDataUrl
methods.description: Checks if a URL is a data:image URL.
